theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiTM_blowUp_integral_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (x : Rn N) (C R r M : ℝ) (h : Rn N → ℝ), 0 < r → 0 < R → μ (Metric.ball x (r * R)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * (r * R) ^ n) → Continuous h → (∀ z, |h z| ≤ M) → (∀ z, h z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ < R) → Integrable (fun y ↦ h (blowUpMap x r y)) μ ∧ |(r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ y, h (blowUpMap x r y) ∂μ| ≤ M * max C 0 * R ^ n
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
